documents.question: How is the Knowledge Level calculated?
documents.answer: Your level (1–10) is calculated from your latest quiz score, weighted by topic difficulty. The 20-question quiz refreshes each cycle so the level reflects current knowledge, not your best ever.

documents.question: Why focus on a different topic next time?
documents.answer: We weight your next quiz toward your weakest area. Improving where you're weakest moves your Knowledge Level fastest — and gives the biggest healthspan return.

documents.question: Where do the questions come from?
documents.answer: Every question is written or vetted by our science team and reviewed against peer-reviewed sources. No marketing claims, no folklore.

documents.question: What happens to my level if I skip a quiz?
documents.answer: Knowledge Level pauses at its last value until you take the next quiz. Your overall Longevity Level still ticks, but Knowledge stops contributing until you re-engage.
